messages.subject: RStan author list
parts:
I don't know how you want to manage the RStan
author list. Right now, it's everyone who contributed
to Stan up to a year or so ago.

I'm OK with your reducing RStan authors to just the
authors of RStan itself. Otherwise, you should probably
add the rest (see the mc-stan.org web site for the full
current list).

- Bob
